sections.title: Decision frame
sections.text:
The deliverable is one protocol repository with two independently native SDKs:

```
spec + fixtures + conformance          engineering evidence (phase ids allowed)
              │
     ┌────────┴────────┐
 PHP package core    Dart package core        public package API (phase ids forbidden)
     │                    │
future consumer/bridge  optional transport companion
```

AzGuard and Chatom inform the engineering standard only.  They are not runtime dependencies,
integration targets, compatibility promises, or names permitted in AgenTools public APIs.

sections.title: Quality baseline
sections.text:
1. **Artifact taxonomy.** `spec/`, `fixtures/`, `conformance/`, `bakeoff/`, `plans/` and findings
   are engineering evidence. Phase IDs may appear there. Public package material is only PHP
   `php/src`/`php/README.md`/Composer metadata and Dart `dart/agentools/lib`/pub metadata/docs;
   phase labels may not leak into its namespaces, exports, package names or user-facing documents.
2. **PHP boundary.** The core has no `illuminate/*`, Laravel, Eloquent, ServiceProvider, CoreX,
   Chatom or AzGuard dependency. Public types are deliberate contracts/value objects; internal
   implementation stays non-exported. Any Laravel bridge needs its own manifest, owner decision,
   consumer test and release lifecycle outside this SDK.
3. **Dart boundary.** `agentools` is pure Dart: no Flutter and no MCP transport dependency in core.
   `agentools_mcp_dart` is a separately named optional companion; it cannot expand core semantics.
4. **Stable API rule.** A public contract is stable only when it is explicitly exported/marked,
   has a production consuming path, and has a behavioural test. No speculative ports/interfaces.
   API additions follow SemVer and an API manifest/snapshot; breaking changes require a major plan.
5. **Truth/release rule.** README, metadata, public exports, changelog/release notes and CI must
   agree. Verification starts from a clean checkout and includes formatter, static analysis,
   unit/architecture tests, conformance and package-consumer smoke tests. One `tools/ci_gate.py`
   orchestrates repository gates; package-native commands remain visible beneath it.

sections.title: Dart-specific implementation baseline
sections.text:
Use conventional public barrel exports from `lib/`; make nullability and asynchronous API changes
explicit and backwards-compatible by default.  Before release run `dart format --output=none
--set-exit-if-changed .`, `dart analyze`, and `dart test`; version and changelog changes are part of
the release evidence. These constraints come from the package-development skill and are encoded in
P8/P11, not assumed from memory.

sections.title: Open owner choices
sections.text:
The legal/publication identity (OSS vs proprietary, license and public registry channels) and
whether DR-01 is ratified or reopened cannot be inferred from repository evidence. They are tracked
as Q-30/Q-31 and gate freeze/SDK metadata rather than being silently decided by this research.
